forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {安|やす}らいでいませんでした

definitions.explanation: to feel peaceful; to relax; to feel calm and comfortable

examples.japanese: ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{安|やす}らぐ。
⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{安|やす}らぐ。
examples.english: Listening to music makes me feel at ease.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{安|やす}らぐ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごせる→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: Being in nature allows me to spend peaceful time where my heart feels at ease.

notes:
{安|やす}らぐ is an intransitive godan verb expressing a state of inner peace and tranquility.

TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). The transitive counterpart is {安|やす}らげる (to soothe, give comfort).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{安|やす}らぐ (one's heart feels at peace)
- {気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{安|やす}らぐ (to feel at ease)
- ⟦{安|やす}らぎ→安らぎ：12238_yasuragi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel peace/comfort)
- ⟦{安|やす}らぎ→安らぎ：12238_yasuragi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (peaceful time)

RELATED NOUN:
⟦{安|やす}らぎ→安らぎ：12238_yasuragi⟧ is the nominalized form meaning "peace, comfort, tranquility."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}く→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧: To calm down (from an agitated state)
- ⟦リラックス→リラックス：02531_rirakkusu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: To relax (more physical)
- {安|やす}らぐ: Emphasizes inner peace and emotional comfort

REGISTER: Neutral to slightly literary. Common in written contexts and poetic expressions.
